description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class 'SlidingTabsColorsFragment' used in an Android app to demonstrate a customizable sliding tab layout with color indicators. It manages tab data, sets up a ViewPager with a FragmentPagerAdapter, and customizes tab indicator and divider colors for each tab.

classes.name: SlidingTabsColorsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment demonstrating a sliding tab layout with colored tabs and a ViewPager.

classes.name: SamplePagerItem
classes.description: Represents individual tab information including title, indicator color, and divider color, and can create associated content fragments.

classes.name: SampleFragmentPagerAdapter
classes.description: A FragmentPagerAdapter that supplies fragments and page titles for the ViewPager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the list of tabs with titles and colors.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewPager and SlidingTabLayout, including custom tab colorization.
